args.notes: System spec: 32 requests/us bursty (all 32 at once per 1us tick), p99 batch latency <= 0.44us. Need throughput >= 32 Msps and err <= 2^-12. Minimise LUTs+FFs, maximise accuracy_bits. Screen with the analytic batch bound at L1, then L2-simulate the shortlist. Prefer designs with enough parallel lanes / pipelined throughput to meet the burst deadline, not just average throughput.
